18.abstract_polytope_caveat: This is only a rational-surface carrier nonexistence theorem.  The classical finite-volume Vinberg--Kaplinskaja hyperbolic P18 exists.
18.geometric_conclusion: No smooth projective rational surface in characteristic zero has complete Mori cone generated by irreducible curve classes with the P18 facet intersection matrix.  Every possible surface-MMP canonical marking lies in the full diagram orbit of K=(-3,1^18); after conjugation the B_18 chain is smooth rational, contracts to P2, and the flex-cubic Abel obstruction applies.

method: exact exhaustive contraction of every current square-minus-one facet image, followed by P2/F2 canonical reconstruction and integral weighted-diagram orbit comparison

nonexistence of carriers on nonrational varieties
a new abstract hyperbolic Coxeter polytope
theorem_scope: unconditional nonexistence of a complete P18 or P19 Mori/nef carrier on a smooth projective rational surface in characteristic zero
